title: Lamb Koftas with Arabian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic Middle Eastern-inspired lamb dish, perfect for a summer evening. The combination of spices and herbs adds a unique twist to traditional koftas.

ingredients.name: Ground Lamb
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works best

ingredients.name: Arabian Spices
ingredients.notes: available in most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (375°F).
2. In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, Arabian spices, olive oil, onion, garlic, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
4. Remove the lamb mixture from the refrigerator and use your hands to shape it into 8-10 koftas, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
5. Thread the koftas onto skewers, if using.
6. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the koftas for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
8. Transfer the koftas to a serving platter and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
9. Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F for 5 minutes.
10. Serve the koftas in the pita bread with your favorite toppings, such as tomato, onion, and tzatziki sauce.
